column1: # 2026-10-23 lazy-load PR 2b A/B. Arm M = master 87676f8 pack (mdl role, Stage 5, 14 baseline files, 29,388 routed words). Arm L = 2b head 59bc033 pack (7 files, 14,600 routed words) plus bin/mdl-rules.sh output for the task's kinds (page task: "page access"; mf: "microflow access"; traps: per trap), since a pack agent cannot run the script. Pack contents byte-identical to the ones rebuilt at 87676f8 / 59bc033 except the header ref. One model (claude-opus-5-5) every rep, fresh `claude -p` per rep with Read/Write only, from an empty cwd with no CLAUDE.md above it; arms interleaved.
# Run 1 (r1-r5 page/mf, trap rows): earlier the same day. Run 2 (page r6-r15): added because run 1 had L page uixref 4/5 vs M 5/5.

# Scorer: score.sh with the mfpre separator fix (accepts ':', em/en dash, ' - '); re-scoring run 1 changed only L-mf-r3 mfpre 0->1, no M row moved. Trap rows: the session's trap scorer (not committed) with trap-18 counted per script (fenced block OR a `-- FILE n of m:` / `-- Script n:` header inside one block); re-scoring changed only L-trap-18-r1/r2 planted 0->1, no M row moved; a negative control (L-trap-18-r1 with its FILE 2 header deleted) still scores planted=0.

# Findings: page over 15 reps per arm: uixref L 14/15 vs M 11/15 (misses in both arms are the same shape: Step 5 checks posted as NOT RUN, no named block); crumbs median 2/3 both, 3/3 in M 2/15 vs L 1/15 (one-rep difference, reported); quoted at 100 M 9/15 vs L 14/15; every other page metric equal. mf 5 reps: L equal or better on every metric. Traps: planted 8/8 both arms after the trap-18 scorer fix; trap-29 exposed M 2 vs L 1 (both pass). read_all 1 on every rep. tool_calls M 7 / L 6; tokens median page M 341k / L 292k.
